producer_report.summary: Producer and verifier briefs for a job that pins a repository now carry a "Pinned source" section with the url, ref and full SHA from the job's PinnedRepo. The section is omitted when there is no pin. The producer brief's hash rule now bars only hashes made during verification. It says to cite the url, ref and SHA from the "Pinned source" section as given. run.rs passes the pin that pin_repo resolved into the producer brief and into the verifier inputs. I did not change the two role prompt files (producer.md, verifier.md), although the brief listed them as deliverables: the producer prompt set went over its token budget (about 1164 against 1100). The brief wording carries the exemption instead. I added tests in briefs.rs and one in run_pin_tests.rs. The test run covering all workspace tests failed once, on a test I had just written. I then ran only athena-context and athena-core, and those passed. I did not re-run the whole workspace after that fix, so the other crates are not re-checked after it.

checks_run.note: Run again after `cargo fmt --all` fixed one wrapped line in run_pin_tests.rs. I did not re-run the check itself afterwards.
20 athena-context tests and 33 athena-core tests passed. They include the new pin tests, the updated hash-rule test and a_study_pins_once_records_the_commit_and_mounts_it_read_only_for_both_agents.

This was the last run of the full workspace. Its only failure was my own test producer_briefs_without_a_pin_have_no_pin_section, because VERIFIER_VISIBILITY itself mentions "Pinned source". I fixed the test to look for the "## Pinned source" heading, then re-ran only the two crates above. Before that, an earlier full run failed on the producer token budget.

open_issues: producer.md and verifier.md are unchanged, although they were listed as deliverables. Changing them needs token room: remove other text from producer.md, or raise the producer budget.

The full-workspace test run was not repeated after the last test fix, so the other crates are not re-checked after it. The earlier full run had already passed the athena-cli budgets and lifecycle tests. Athena's own run of cargo test --locked will confirm.
mistakes: I first added lines to the producer and verifier prompts and bumped both frame versions to 2. That broke the producer token budget, so I reverted the prompt text and the version bumps.
My first pin-section test matched the phrase "Pinned source", which the rule text also contains, and failed.
I called show_file in the new run_pin_tests.rs assertions as if it returned a String. It returns bytes, so it failed to compile until I converted it.
learnings: The producer role set is near its 1,100-token budget, which the budgets test in athena-cli enforces. Any addition to producer.md fails every_role_set_is_within_its_budget unless something is removed.
VERIFIER_VISIBILITY is part of the producer brief only, and it names "Pinned source". A test for an absent pin section must therefore look for the "## Pinned source" heading, not the phrase.
Job records already hold the pin (Job.pin). The verifier path in run.rs reads it through ctx.job.job, so RunContext needed no new field.
